scope: Targeted current-state checks only. Effective dates are deposit dates plus the treaty-defined three calendar months where relevant; no individual date or deadline is inferred. Historical and continuing violations require individual review. No global participation lookup defaults to confirmed.

countries.detailZh: 2006-01-24批准ICCPR；2009-06-30批准OP。OP声明限生效后国家行为；事件时间与国家管辖仍须个案核对。
countries.detailEn: ICCPR ratified 2006-01-24; OP ratified 2009-06-30. The OP declaration concerns State acts after its entry into force; event timing and jurisdiction require separate review.

countries.detailZh: 1969-03-18批准ICCPR；2011-06-29加入OP。国内援引、事件时间及受理要件另核。
countries.detailEn: ICCPR ratified 1969-03-18; OP acceded to 2011-06-29. Domestic effect, event timing and admissibility remain separate.

countries.detailZh: 1976-05-20批准ICCPR；英国未参加第一任择议定书。ICCPR缔约不能替代个人来文国家资格。
countries.detailEn: ICCPR ratified 1976-05-20. The UK is not party to OP1; Covenant participation does not establish individual-communication competence.

countries.detailZh: UNTC IV.4脚注6记载ICCPR在香港特别行政区继续适用。不得从中国内地状态推导；香港未获第一任择议定书程序的领土适用。
countries.detailEn: UNTC IV.4 note 6 records continued Covenant application to Hong Kong SAR. Mainland status is not a proxy; OP1 individual communications have not been extended to Hong Kong.

countries.detailZh: 中国1998-10-05签署ICCPR，当前未批准（香港等领土安排须独立核对）；未参加OP1。这里只可作清楚标示的比较标准。
countries.detailEn: China signed the ICCPR on 1998-10-05 but has not ratified it; territorial arrangements such as Hong Kong require separate review. China is not party to OP1. References are comparative only.

countries.detailZh: 马来西亚未列ICCPR/OP1参与方表。可保留国际比较标准，不写作其ICCPR条约义务。
countries.detailEn: Malaysia is not a participant in the ICCPR or OP1 tables. International references are comparative standards, not its Covenant treaty obligations.

countries.detailZh: ICCPR参与方；OP于1991-10-01加入，声明限其生效后情势/事件。不得将历史欧洲人权法院程序迁移至2022-09-16之后的新事件。
countries.detailEn: ICCPR participant; OP accession 1991-10-01 with a temporal declaration. Historical ECtHR proceedings cannot be transferred to events after 2022-09-16.

countries.detailZh: 白俄罗斯仍为ICCPR参与方，但OP退出于2023-02-08生效。新来文受此限制；退出前已提交事项须按OP第12(2)条另核，旧案不自动关闭。
countries.detailEn: Belarus remains an ICCPR participant but OP denunciation took effect 2023-02-08. New communications are restricted; pre-existing submissions require separate OP Article 12(2) review and are not automatically closed.
